scope: RC02 registered provider and actual official GitHub REST GET only; no production runtime, business DB, models or manufactured event
checks: Registered provider accepted exact allowlisted official PR facts after official /user principal verification.
A live baseline is distinct from a new HEAD event; unchanged live facts produce no event.
Rebuilding the provider with the previous baseline does not manufacture an event from unchanged facts.
Current scope revocation prevents facts/tracking authorization and sends zero new requests.
Authorization revoked after an actual PR GET returns prevents accepting its bytes.
A new provider with no credential rejects facts before network.
Observe mode rejects provider facts and tracking without network.
limits: This verifies the registered provider transport, not a full production factory/runtime or real-model collaboration.
No PR, comment, review, branch or commit was modified. No business DB or token ledger was opened.
The previous baseline is passed in memory across provider reconstruction; this is not SQLite or service recovery evidence.
Natural changes, if any, are recorded as observations and do not establish the RC04 wake/revision/re-review acceptance chain.
